newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers surge in late trade.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers surge in late trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices surged in late trade on Thursday in what players said could be supply-side driven pressure on the market amid higher cargo prices.
The surge ended a slip in bunkers values that began early last week amid the fall of NYMEX crude oil futures.
In the Gulf Coast, spot Houston 380 CST rose $10, trading between $116 a tonne and $118 a tonne. 180 CST also rose about $10 to $11, trading $119/120.
"The surge seems to be tied into the shortage of fuel combined with cargo markets being up," said one trader.
